changes.title: Slack arc
items: Slack leashes curve up higher, and flatten out straight as they go taut

changes.title: Sigil weight
items: Your sigils have weight: a big posse trailing behind pulls on you, slowing you as you pull away from it, slowing your climb, and slowly drawing you down from the treetops (the first few sigils weigh almost nothing)

changes.title: Angry legend line
items: An angry legend's note now says it also settles back to sleep when one of its children is back in its area
